content.description: Protect your Discord community from scams, phishing, and malicious actors. SecurityBot is the leading scam prevention bot for Web3 and NFT servers. Known Scammer Network Take advantage of the entire SecurityBot network to automatically ban known scammers from your community before they're even a problem. Bot Purging SecurityBot's anti-raid features like automated bot purging and in-channel CAPTCHA-based verification keep your Discord server free from bot attacks, without impacting real members.
